plotEn: Clarissa is a 2026 drama film directed and produced by Arie Esiri and Chuko Esiri. A modern-day reimagining of the 1925 novel Mrs Dalloway by Virginia Woolf, it is set in contemporary Lagos, Nigeria and follows a high-society woman who finds herself looking back on her past when she is reunited with former friends and lovers. It stars Sophie Okonedo and India Amarteifio as the older and younger versions of the title character. The supporting cast includes David Oyelowo, Toheeb Jimoh, Jude Akuwud
